nodes.norm_label: source layout (src/core, src/ui, src/app, libs/bestyle, tests)
nodes.rationale: src/core is plain C++ with no Qt so the engine is testable and independent of the interface.

nodes.label: Logievo (node-based AI model editor)
nodes.rationale: Engine is plain C++ with no machine-learning library; tensors, shapes, gradients and training are hand-written in src/core.

nodes.label: Git subtree sharing via tools/bestyle.sh
nodes.rationale: Each app carries bestyle as a git subtree so building needs nothing extra; changes are pushed/pulled across bemotion, Artisan and others.

nodes.label: Procedure to add a node type
nodes.norm_label: procedure to add a node type
nodes.rationale: Node type and parameter ids are saved in files, so they must never be renamed.

nodes.label: Isometric L Monogram
nodes.rationale: A 3D-extruded letter L (white vertical wall, gray floor plane) evokes the Logievo initial and a spatial/architectural feel.

nodes.label: Rounded-Square Icon Container
nodes.rationale: Squircle-style dark tile matches mobile/desktop app icon conventions.

nodes.label: graphify usage rules (query before grep, update after edits)
nodes.norm_label: graphify usage rules (query before grep, update after edits)
nodes.rationale: Scoped subgraph queries are smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output; graph.json is rewritten whole each build so large diffs are expected.

nodes.label: Code node (custom formula, dual-number derivatives)
nodes.rationale: Derivatives are computed automatically with dual numbers so user formulas train like any built-in node.

nodes.norm_label: project templates (linear regression, mlp, rnn, tensors, custom code node)

nodes.norm_label: color tokens read at paint time
nodes.rationale: Themes change while the app runs, so colors must be tokens (theme::kText) and labels toned via setTone, never baked style sheets.
